intro.title: Meet Pranav
intro.text: Hi, I'm Pranav. I build AI-powered products, and I'm the founder of Learning Destiny. I started in Hyderabad, and I'm now based in Austin, Texas. I'm pursuing a master's in Information Technology Management at Webster University. Explore my projects, or say hello. I'd love to connect.

projects.title: My projects
projects.text: My projects focus on helping people take their next step. I developed an AI Resume Reviewer that offers feedback, A T S scoring, and improvement suggestions. I also designed an AI Interview Coach for mock interviews and personalized feedback. Learning Destiny AI is my overseas education assistant, designed for university matching, statement of purpose guidance, visa checklists, and application tracking.

journey.title: My journey
journey.text: My journey started with a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science from Om Sterling Global University. I completed two graduate quarters in Technology Innovation at the University of Washington before discontinuing my studies. I'm now pursuing a Master of Science in Information Technology Management at Webster University, with expected completion in twenty twenty-seven.
